name: the hyperdex
headline: The *Hyperdex*
say: And here is the first thing anyone sees. Remember the simplest pattern: a name, and what it holds, named by its own signature. Read from outside, every hive is exactly that: an index of names and signatures. That index is called a Hyperdex, from hyper and index. It is not something built beside your hive. It is your hive, seen from the door. The root of your domain serves it, signed, and it is the first impression anyone has of you. What it shows depends on the place: on a phone, it is the people you hold. And it can take many shapes, a list, a honeycomb, a wall of cards, with your business card as one entry among them. Visit someone's domain, and their Hyperdex is how they greet you.
